prompt: Camera locked, looking up past the seated heads. At once the masked auctioneer, standing behind the wooden lectern, holds his black gloved palm out flat towards the room in a calm, firm "stop", keeping it there for a beat. Then he brings the gavel in his other hand down once on the lectern with a sharp crack, and goes still. His navy balaclava stays exactly the same throughout: the white ring around the face area and the small red triangle over his left eye, fully covering his head, with no opening; only the knitted fabric shows. The blackboard behind keeps its crossed-out figure and "£50" readable. Rain trickles down the clear tent wall behind. Sound: a hush in the crowd, one loud wooden gavel knock, rain on canvas. Soft natural light.
